text.en:
The Ilagan Electric and Ice Plant, Incorporated, is granted an extension of thirty days, from the
date of the approval hereof, to file its acceptance of the franchise awarded under Act Numbered Thirty-four
hundred and ninety-four of the Philippine Legislature and to make the deposit therein required.
Such franchise shall at all times be subject to the limitations provided in the Constitution.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, March 31, 1938.
